films.credit: Filmed by @mukbangyourmama · Walnut Creek shop, 2335 Oak Grove Road; the original review includes the creator’s mixed impressions.
films.caption:
the most extra cookies🍪 @chipcookies.bayarea 

🍪 If you like your cookies simple, I’m right there with you. But if you’re more like my boyfriend and want ALL the bells and whistles, fillings, toppings, and a decadent dessert, then Chip Cookies in Walnut Creek might be your spot! 😂

They have your classic cookies, but also jazzed-up creations that take things to another level. Think stuffed cookies, extra toppings, and all the sweet stuff that makes each bite feel like a whole dessert on its own.

🍪 BTS Chip: A fun, loaded cookie, but the base was a little overdone this time, making it harder than I would’ve liked.

🍪 Oreo Dunk Chip: For the Oreo lovers! Another one where the base was a bit too hard on this visit.

🍰 Tres Leches Chip: A decadent option if you want something a little different from your typical cookie.

🤎 Biscoff Cookie: Their most popular cookie, so if you’re visiting for the first time, this is probably the one to try!

Overall, the cookies are usually pretty good, even though the BTS and Oreo cookies were a little overbaked this time around. I’m definitely more of a simple cookie girl, but I can see the appeal if you love an extra-indulgent treat. These are also a great option to bring to a party or share with a big group since there’s something for everyone!

What we ordered:
🍪 BTS Chip
🍪 Oreo Dunk Chip
🍰 Tres Leches Chip
🤎 Biscoff Cookie
